Immediate attention is needed to evaluate whether the top Google campaign ("LocalServicesCampaign:SystemGenerated:000656b9a9b1ed48" at $1,437.17) is generating qualified leads or simply burning budget without converting.

performance.verdict: Five overdue SOW milestones expose zero signed cases; Meta is the only paying channel.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting all overdue since 2026-07-31/08-01 — blocking attribution and qualified lead flow.
CPL surged 259% week-over-week to $160.25; Google Ads spent $2,601.27 over 28 days but GHL records 0 won opportunities from 101 created — spend efficiency is unconfirmable.
Meta delivered all 23 tracked leads at $1,084.40 (28-day CPL ~$47); 3-day lead total (Sep 18–20) is 1 vs prior 3-day total (Sep 15–17) of 3 — short-term deceleration confirmed.
GHL shows 101 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments — leads are arriving but no intake conversion is occurring; this is a pipeline/intake leak, not an ads failure.
GBP actions dropped 19.35% week-over-week; last 2 days show 0 GBP actions, suggesting organic local visibility is softening alongside paid pressure.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no budget scaling until stack test and tracking pass.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones — Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages Live, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — are overdue by 51–52 days with no completed event recorded. Google Ads has spent $2,601.27 in the 28-day window with 0 confirmed won cases and attribution unverified. Nacer to confirm completion status or set a hard deadline by 2026-09-25. Success = all five items marked complete or a revised delivery date logged in Monday.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake leak: 101 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments — confirm routing, speed-to-lead, and follow-up cadence are live.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 101 opportunities created over 28 days with 0 won and 0 appointments booked — leads are entering the pipeline but not converting, indicating a routing or follow-up failure, not an ads problem. Confirm that instant assignment, the 5-minute first-contact rule, and the missed-call-text-back cadence are all active per SOW. Success check: at least 1 booked appointment visible in GHL by 2026-09-28. If none, escalate to Nacer for intake team audit.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL: 3-day leads fell to 1 from 3; hold budget at current level and re-check Sep 24.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta leads dropped from 3 in the Sep 15–17 window to 1 in Sep 18–20, a short-term deceleration after being the only channel delivering leads at ~$47 CPL over 28 days. Re-check on 2026-09-24; if the 3-day total remains at 1 or below, escalate to a creative_refresh recommendation.
